edits.new:
Then every alert links one runbook entry with the check, the owner role and the recovery step, and the capacity per environment is stated as a values entry

  Scenario: AC9 Each business rule BR1 to BR9 holds in the deployment (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the deployment of rwb-source-data in SIT
    When the checks for the rules BR1 to BR9 in section 8 are run
    Then each rule BR1 to BR9 is verified by its test case in section 16
    Then a rule that is an architecture constraint is verified by a guardrail or boundary test named in section 16

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is handled (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the service reads ACE only through the recovery.v_ace_* views
    When a consumed read of v_ace_batch_status fails or gets no answer
    Then the failure is counted and no stamp is guessed
    Then no job is held on a stamp the read did not return

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a data_product_load row with its current status
    When a status change the status model does not allow is submitted
    Then the change is refused and the stored status is unchanged
    Then the refusal is counted and the row is not written
